decisions.reason: The organic sliced salami platter is a flagship of the firm's stated push into organic lines, sits close to its core competence, and offers several variants that can be adjusted rather than withdrawn.

Organic poultry mini salami snacks fit the organic and snacking growth direction and are featured on their own page, though as a single niche item they carry somewhat higher listing risk at retailers.
The premium sharing salami snack line builds on the firm's curing and maturation strengths, is prominently presented, and targets a growing convenience segment in an expanding market.
